description: Get the claim ledger for one essay: each load-bearing claim it makes, the source it was checked against, the quoted words, where in the source they appear, the date the source was read, and a status saying how the claim was checked. The response defines every status. Filter by claim ids or status, or ask for compact rows. Claims removed during checking are listed separately under "struck", with the reason; they are not claims the essay makes. Only some essays have a ledger: search results and get_essay link to one when it exists. These tools retrieve The Durability Curve's public material. They do not certify that any claim is true.

compact.description: true: each claim as id, status, claim, source, source_url, locator and date_read only (no quoted words or essay sentence).

slug.description: The essay's site or Substack slug (case-insensitive), or its full durabilitycurve.com/blog/ or harryfloyd.substack.com/p/ URL.

status.description: Only claims with this status, by its key or label (e.g. "VERIFIED" or "Verified"); the response lists every status.

name: get_claim_ledger
title: Get a claim ledger
